about: The engine modes the runtime's behavioural suite runs against (RH-07 #408). One row per engine and mode in testdata/engine-profiles/profiles.json, and nothing else: the suite refuses to start when the two disagree. A row says only what differs by mode; every assertion is the same for every row. See docs/testing-engine-suite.md.

homeOwners.app-id: a file the app user writes into a bind-mounted home belongs, on the host, to the app's own PUID
homeOwners.engine-user: it belongs to the engine's own user, the Quasar user (decision D14, Podman keep-id)
homeOwners.subordinate-id: it belongs to one of the engine user's subordinate ids: rootless Docker has no per-container mapping (the documented D14 gap)
